Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000708" [decision]: As of 2025-09-30, the billing API will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing API, feature-flags, new invoice flow)
- memory_id "1000615": As of 2025-09-02, feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of them were identical.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000611" [decision]: As of 2025-09-02, clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: feature-flags, clients)
- memory_id "1000356": As of 2025-04-24, feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000183": The job scheduler depends on feature-flags for per-job kill switches.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000041": feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000772": On 2025-11-04, the Ember team noticed that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it, as it is not their service.  (about: billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000521": On 2025-06-09, the Ember team handed the billing API to the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000644" [decision]: On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000729": As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000713" [preference]: As of 2025-09-30, the Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000538" [preference]: As of 2025-07-21, the Ember team runs its planning on Fridays.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000733" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by Cinder, having transferred from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000401": As of 2025-05-20, the Atlas team owns the indexer, having taken it over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000652": As of 2025-09-16, the authentication gateway is owned by Cinder, having been handed over by the Ember team.  (about: Cinder, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000296" [constraint]: As of 2025-03-31, anything Ember-related should be paged to Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000240": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000488": As of 2025-06-11, the notifier went to the Dune team, which the Boreal team owned until 2025-06-11; the Cinder team never owned the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, Cinder, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000557": As of 2025-07-30, the Atlas team consists of Priya Raman, after Tomasz left the team for the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000750": As of 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000551": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000516": As of 2025-06-09, the billing API lives with the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)

[2025-11-06] handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags: Quick one: feature-flags belongs to team Ember starting today. Thanks to team Atlas for running it until now.
